Zayan is a nine-year-old South Asian boy with a slender build and warm brown skin. He has tight dark curls framing a round face with wide eyes and a small nose. He wears a bright red hoodie, color #E4572E, featuring a frayed left cuff, paired with dark slate-blue pants, color #2E4057. A thick red rubber band rests around his left wrist as a sensory tool. He wears scuffed white sneakers with thick rubber soles. At rest, his posture is dynamic and asymmetrical, with his weight shifted onto the balls of his feet and his knees slightly bent, appearing as though he is caught mid-motion and ready to sprint. Scene: Zayan sprints across the school playground to release his hyperactive energy, determined to sneak back inside to retrieve his favorite glowing bounce-ball from the science storage closet before the weekend. Setting: EXT. OAK CREEK ELEMENTARY - PLAYGROUND - DAY. Camera: wide establishing. Light: soft morning light. Palette: #E4572E, #2E4057.
